== Biography ==
'''Doran''' is from Governador Valadares, MG.

== Trivia ==
* His nickname comes from the '''[[wikipedia:en:Magic: The Gathering|Magic: The Gathering]]''' card called '''"Doran the Siege Tower"'''.
* He is often referred by his players and fans just as "Coach D".
